name: Bomb Defuse
hook: One sees the bomb. Everyone else has the manual.
how: The defuser sees wires, a big button, a symbol keypad and a maze, but no rules. The others have the manual but can't see the bomb. Talk fast: every mistake is a strike and makes the clock run faster.
controls: Click or tap wires, keys and the button (hold it when told); arrow keys or tap the grid for the maze; quick-chat buttons or type
uses: The bomb is sealed so only the defuser can see it (the host makes it, so it can too).
The host's browser runs the clock and checks every cut and press; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Alone, a bot named Tock reads you the manual, one rule at a time.
The most bombs your team defused in a row.
ideas: Add a module with a dial you turn to the right number
Make the defuser change every module instead of every bomb
Set it in a spy lab with laser tripwires
